name: mutual-bank
description: Member-owned mutual bank, run through the challenged-return engine

lore.assertion: The security-register migration of 2023 carried collateral-valuation mappings over as a one-off exercise, and the revaluation schedules attached to them were never re-baselined.

constrains.effect: Carried-over mappings drift from the register

lore.assertion: Regulatory returns lodge on the due date; an open review challenge is logged against the return, not treated as blocking.

constrains.effect: Filing over an open challenge is an accepted, recorded decision

lore.assertion: The three-lines charter: audit reports functionally to the board audit committee and administratively to the CEO.

constrains.effect: Second-line review precedes lodgement; the record shows when it was overridden
